label: Anterior inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery
synonyms: Anterior branch of inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery
Anterior part of inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery

tier1.text: An artery that branches from the inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery. It courses on the anterior surface of the uncinate process continuing on to the head of the pancreas. It supplies the uncinate process, head of the pancreas, and the second and third parts of the duodenum.
